welcome_message:
Create an AAI evaluation project

A standalone evaluation harness for an existing application or endpoint: curated Unity Catalog datasets, reusable deterministic scorers plus LLM judges, pinned baselines, a CI regression gate, and published results.

project_name.description: Project and bundle name. NOTE: apply template updates deliberately — generated projects record their template version in .aai-template.json
project_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

application_name.description: Application identifier used in tags and traces

catalog.description: Unity Catalog catalog (hosts the evaluation datasets)

schema.description: Unity Catalog schema for evaluation datasets

model_deployment.description: Databricks serving endpoint used by the LLM judges (gateway-fronted; route Foundry models through an external-model endpoint first)

dataset_name.description: Unity Catalog evaluation dataset name (created by scripts/sync_dataset.py)
dataset_name.pattern_match_failure_message: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.

aai_core_volume.description: Unity Catalog volume holding aai-core wheels

aai_core_pip_source.description: pip-installable aai-core source used only by credential-free CI; MUST resolve to exactly aai_core_version (default: the release git tag; for an internal index use 'aai-core=={{.aai_core_version}}'). Runtime jobs always install the checksum-pinned volume wheel

success_message:
{{.project_name}} created.

Next steps:
  1. cd {{.project_name}}
  2. make install                      # pinned SDK + dependencies
  3. make check                        # deterministic tier, zero credentials
  4. python scripts/sync_dataset.py    # publish cases to the UC dataset
  5. make evaluate                     # full judge gate + published report

Run `make help` for every available target.
